quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 mix, margins and test subsidiary (IR deck 09-18-2026, KRW M, before audit): gross margin 23.2% vs 17.9% in H1 2025; operating margin 8.9% vs 4.5% (operating profit 118.9% YoY); segment revenue YoY - semiconductor 205,558 (12.5%), IT electronic materials 53,386 (26.9%), secondary battery 28,341 (-19.4%). Nepes Ark (test) H1 2026: revenue 60,876 (-1.1%), gross margin 26.4% vs 14.1%, operating profit 10,115 vs 3,743 (16.6% margin vs 6.1%), net income 11,985. Technology positioning in the deck: new-growth technologies are chip-last on RDL interposer, double-side RDL with device mount and 2.5D chiplet; the company claims Korea's first WLP development and the world's first 300mm FOWLP and 600mm FOPLP production, and describes itself as a pure advanced-packaging OSAT and the core back-end foundry of the K-semiconductor belt offering turnkey WLP, probe test, assembly and final test.
